sections.title: Observation of universal hierarchical relaxation in a quantum simulator
sections.abstract: The authors use a trapped-ion quantum simulator to demonstrate the theoretically predicted relaxation-overlap inequality and its hierarchy of relaxation exponents in the diffusive regime, extending the theory to multiple conservation laws.
sections.claimed_result: Experimental demonstration of the relaxation-overlap inequality in the diffusive regime.
sections.caveat: The abstract specifies the diffusive regime; broader universality remains to be tested.

sections.title: Deep thermalization and Hilbert space ergodicity
sections.abstract: A review of deep thermalization and Hilbert-space ergodicity and their maximum-entropy framework for irreversible behavior from reversible quantum dynamics.
sections.claimed_result: A unifying framework for forms of ergodicity under physical constraints.
sections.caveat: The abstract presents synthesis and open directions rather than a new direct measurement.

sections.title: Incipient superconductivity and tunable Chern insulators in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene
sections.abstract: Experiments report tunable Chern insulators and a gate-controlled pocket of incipient superconductivity in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene.
sections.claimed_result: Incipient superconductivity and tunable Chern insulators in one graphene platform.
sections.caveat: Resistance does not fall to zero, so the superconductivity claim is preliminary.

sections.title: Design Principles for Ultra-High-Rate Quantum Codes
sections.abstract: The authors develop construction principles for compact ultra-high-rate quantum error-correcting codes and identify favorable code tradeoffs.
sections.claimed_result: Systematic strategies and compact constructions for the Pareto frontier of ultra-high-rate codes.
sections.caveat: Hardware implementation and decoding costs remain unresolved.

sections.title: Multi-messenger and multi-band signal from first-order phase transitions in proto-neutron stars
sections.abstract: Modeling predicts correlated kHz and MHz gravitational waves and a delayed neutrino burst from accretion-driven first-order phase transitions in proto-neutron stars.
sections.claimed_result: A multi-messenger, multi-band signal whose correlations could constrain dense-matter physics.
sections.caveat: Detectability and robustness depend on transition and equation-of-state assumptions.

sections.title: Stress-testing the spatially flat Universe: nonparametric spatial curvature determination from DESI DR2
sections.abstract: DESI DR2 BAO and supernova data analyzed with a Gaussian-process prior yield mildly positive spatial-curvature estimates without CMB data or parametric dark energy.
sections.claimed_result: The baseline analyses mildly favor an open universe, with estimates dependent on sample and setup.
sections.caveat: The uncertainties include zero and results depend on prior, sample, and redshift selection.
